visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a silver necklace, sits on a sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. She holds a yellow Pompompurin plush toy and smiles warmly while speaking. In front of her is a grey laptop on a wooden table. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up screen capture of a laptop showing the FamilyMart Taiwan website. A finger points at the screen, navigating through the 'Fami!ce' menu. High-contrast digital text, colorful food product images, and brand logos are visible on the white web interface. The lighting is the flat, bright glow of a computer display. (3) The woman reappears briefly, gesturing with her hands while explaining. The camera cuts back to the screen recording which displays a green map of Taiwan and a detailed store list for Taipei's Songshan District. Specific icons representing different soft-serve flavors and shapes are visible next to store names. The background of her room shows soft indoor lighting and decorative pillows. (4) The final phase shows the woman standing outdoors on a city sidewalk during daytime. She wears a white cropped top and dark jeans, holding a brown and white swirled soft-serve ice cream in a pink cone. She smiles at the camera and makes a peace sign with her hand. Behind her is a FamilyMart store entrance with visible signage and glass windows reflecting the bright daylight.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: FamilyMart. [Subtitle]: 欸，你想買全家霜淇淋. (2) [Subtitle]: 但跑好多家都買不到嗎？. (3) [Subtitle]: 對啊，我跑好多家都找不到. (4) [Subtitle]: 沒關係，我現在就來教你輕鬆買到！. (5) [Subtitle]: 只要在全家官網點選「最愛吃在全家的 Fami!ce」. (6) [Subtitle]: 進去後就會看到新推出的口味是什麼. (7) [Subtitle]: 像這次就是仙草和牛奶的口味. (8) [Subtitle]: 往下滑就會看到「店舖查詢」. (9) [Subtitle]: 只要點進去，就可以依照店名、店號等等輸入離你最近的分店. (10) [Subtitle]: 或者直接選旁邊的地區. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們來看看附近的全家. (12) [Subtitle]: 這邊，點臺北市、松山區、南京東路五段. (13) [Subtitle]: 有了有了，這條路上有四間. (14) [Subtitle]: 接著看旁邊特殊服務欄裡有什麼圖案. (15) [Subtitle]: 對照左邊的圖例說明，就可以知道這間店有賣什麼種類的冰啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 像這家分店就有賣，而且是單口味的特殊造型. (17) [Subtitle]: 輕鬆買到想吃的霜淇淋了，命中率百分百，你也快來試試.
